query:
DELETE FROM published_paths
            WHERE cache_id = $1
                AND id IN (
                    SELECT id
                    FROM published_paths
                    WHERE cache_id = $1
                        AND created_at < $2
                        AND NOT nix_path_pinned(cache_id, store_path_hash, NOW())
                    ORDER BY created_at, id
                    LIMIT 500
                )
            RETURNING store_path_hash
